query_plan.query: How many airlines have more than ten thousand employees?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by airline id, count the amount.
steps.query: Return all airlines with more than ten thousand employees, with their airline id and airline name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS airline_count FROM airlines WHERE employees > 10000 AND employees IS NOT NULL

s1.sql_query: SELECT airlines.airline, airlines.name, airlines.employees FROM airlines WHERE airlines.employees > 10000 AND airlines.employees IS NOT NULL
